# orly

> A Claude Code plugin that gates the end of every turn. The goal becomes yes/no questions
> in `.orly/specs/`; a Stop hook asks a System One judge (jev) every question about a bounded
> record of the turn in one request and blocks the stop, naming the gap, until every answer
> holds. A `require` spec is decided by a command and costs no tokens. Under 500 lines.

- [README](README.md): what it does, install, usage.
- [Writing specs](docs/specs.txt): the spec tree, headers, the four rules, the state the judge sees.
- `bin/orly.ts`: `orly hook | judge | specs | ask | tree`; `src/orly.ts`: the whole core.
